Field.name: ImageInputFile
Field.usage: Montaged image input file to be analyzed

Field.name: PieceListInput
Field.usage: File with list of piece coordinates for image input file
Field.manpage: File with list of piece coordinates for image input file.

Field.name: RootNameForFiles
Field.manpage: Root name for temporary files. The program will append -fg and the starting and ending section numbers to create the full root name. This name is used for the input parameter file (.param), files for image output and text output from Blendmont (.imtmp and .out), and the files created by Blendmont for edge functions (.xef, .yef) and edge correlations (.ecd).

Field.name: DistortionField
Field.usage: Image distortion field file to use for undistorting images
Field.manpage: Image distortion field file to use for undistorting images. The undistortion is applied when computing edge functions.

Field.name: ImagesAreBinned
Field.usage: The current binning of the images
Field.manpage: The current binning of the images, so that the image distortion field can be applied correctly. This entry is required when doing image distortion corrections unless the program can determine the binning unambiguously from the image size.

Field.name: GradientFile
Field.usage: File with base magnification gradients for each image
Field.manpage: File with magnification gradients for each section; the minimization will determine the amounts to be added to these gradients. This should be a file listing the tilt angle, the percent magnification change per micron of Z height, and the degrees of rotation per micron of Z height for each section, such as is produced by Extractmaggrad.

Field.name: AdjustedFocus
Field.usage: Focus was adjusted for changing Z height when montage was acquired

Field.name: AddToGradient
Field.usage: Starting values for the mag and rotation gradients
Field.manpage: This option provides starting values for the minimization. The reported gradient is not incremental to these values, unlike when a gradient file is entered. The magnification gradient correction is specified by two parameters: % of mag change per micron of Z height, and degrees of rotation per micron of Z height. If -gradient has been entered, the values entered here will be treated as incremental to the values in the gradient file for each section. If -gradient has not been entered, the values entered here will be used for all sections; but in this case the -geometry option must be entered to provide additional information.

Field.name: TiltGeometry
Field.usage: Specify pixel size, tilt axis rotation angle, and tilt angle
Field.manpage: This entry can be used in place of a gradient file to specify the pixel size in nanometers, tilt axis rotation angle, and tilt angle to be used for the gradient computation. The entry has no effect if a gradient file is provided.

Field.name: TiltFile
Field.usage: File with tilt angles only (used if no mag gradient file)
Field.manpage: Name of file with tilt angles, one per line. These angles will be used only if there is no mag gradient file to supply the tilt angles.

Field.name: OffsetTilts
Field.usage: Add given value to tilt angles from gradient or tilt file
Field.manpage: Add the given value to the tilt angles from the gradient file or the tilt file. For a search of 1 or 3 parameters, this value will be used as the starting value for finding the best offset.

Field.name: SectionsToDo
Field.usage: Sections on which to minimize overlap errors
Field.manpage: List of sections on which to minimize overlap errors; comma-separated ranges are allowed. The mean error over all of these sections will be minimized unless the -separate option is included, in which case the procedure is run separately on each section.

Field.name: RunSeparately
Field.usage: Run minimization separately on each section
Field.manpage: Run minimization separately on each section, instead of combining the errors from all sections. With this option, the list of sections must be specified with -sections.

Field.name: SearchType
Field.usage: 1/-1 to find tilt offset, 2/-2 to find gradient, 3 to find both
Field.manpage: Enter 1 or -1 to find just the tilt offset with a fixed mag gradient, 2 or -2 to find the mag gradient with a fixed tilt offset, and 3 to find both the mag gradient and the best tilt offset. The latter should be used only when multiple sections with a big difference in their tilt angles are searched together (not separately). The positive values do a search with a simplex algorithm. Use -2 to find gradients with a routine that uses an estimated gradient from Blendmont to modify the gradient until it converges. This method is faster and seems to be slightly more reliable. Use -1 to search for the tilt offset with a simple routine that is faster and probably as reliable as the simplex routine.

Field.name: TraceOutput
Field.usage: Output values during minimization: 1 for minima, 2 for all values

Field.name: BlendOption
Field.usage: Option and value to pass to Blendmont
Field.manpage: Option and value to pass to Blendmont. This option will be added the end of the .param file. There is no check for whether options entered this way conflict with the options placed into the .param file by findgradient.

Field.name: ParameterFile
Field.manpage: Read parameter entries as keyword-value pairs from a parameter file.
